file_roles.evidence: my_decimal2int gets a round_type parameter instead of hard-coded HALF_UP; needed so the partition code can pass FLOOR, default behaviour unchanged.
Declaration adds `decimal_round_mode round_type= HALF_UP` default; API adaptation for the real fix.
part_val_int used item_expr->val_int() (HALF_UP rounding of 9.9 to 10); diff handles DECIMAL_RESULT via my_decimal2int(..., FLOOR).

rationale: The report shows 9.9 placed in the p2 partition because the decimal is rounded up before partition lookup. part_val_int in sql_partition.cc is changed to floor decimals. The my_decimal files only add the parameter plumbing.
